acceptedClaims: A real Finance ExecutionOrderIntent can satisfy the caller JSON schema while failing current Finance owner-native execution admission. Schema validity is therefore insufficient at a real capital consequence boundary.

Finance execution.request.prepare@1 is a suitable owner-native admission surface for pre-reservation Agent intent: it binds mechanical identity, executes current C2 authority/economic checks, and remains read-only.
The existing Harness validate_conclusion hook can host Finance-owned admission without moving Finance truth or authority into Harness.

Within one natural live gated Run, Finance rejection caused the same Agent to revise an inadmissible delegated order from size 13 to size 12 and reach an admitted objective-satisfying candidate. Real-domain correction value is established.

Within another replicate of the same case, repeated Finance rejection did not converge before the current correction budget was exhausted. The admission hook is valuable but the current correction protocol is not reliably self-correcting.
Harness currently labels a Finance authority/budget rejection as incomplete/missing evidence. That feedback wording is semantically over-specialized and can misdirect the Agent.

Harness currently accounts conclusion rejection as Tool correction and bounds it with max_tool_corrections even when toolCalls=0. Tool correction and conclusion correction are distinct mechanics and should not share one semantic counter.

Finance admission and Agent task optimality are distinct. Several candidates were Finance-admitted while missing the experiment objective, so the owner gate must not be promoted into a generic optimizer or task-success oracle.

Protocol-v1 results that exposed evaluator targets to the Agent are excluded rather than reused. Evaluation truth must remain outside the Agent-visible source world unless the task itself legitimately supplies it.
rejectedClaims: The aggregate 14/16 versus 11/16 Finance-admission difference is a clean causal estimate of the gate effect; treatments use independent stochastic Provider samples.
A Finance-admitted intent is necessarily the best or objective-satisfying intent.
Every Finance structured result should be forced through one universal Harness semantic verifier.
Harness should learn Finance notional, authority, market-basis, or order-shape semantics.
Conclusion rejection is just another Tool-call correction and needs no separate accounting.
A domain rejection necessarily means evidence is missing.
The one non-decodable terminal conclusion can already be attributed to a specific Harness fallback path; exact live provenance was not captured.
The excluded protocol-v1 decisions may contribute to accuracy or treatment statistics.
